sources.title: String Inflation After Planck 2013

evidence.text: How do string-inflation models fare against Planck 2013 constraints on spectral tilt, primordial tensors, non-Gaussianity and dark radiation, and what does their theoretical control suggest about future tensor searches?

sources.title: Fitting string inflation to real cosmological data: The fiber inflation case

evidence.text: Which combinations of Fibre Inflation parameters fit the cosmological datasets used in this 2020 analysis, and what conditional bounds do those fits impose on underlying string coupling, compactification volume and discrete brane flux?

sources.title: String Inflation After Planck 2013

evidence.text: For single-field slow-roll models, the review uses n_s−1 = 2η−6ε and r = 16ε to connect effective scalar potentials to observables, then compares prediction ranges with WMAP and Planck constraints.

sources.title: Fitting string inflation to real cosmological data: The fiber inflation case

evidence.text: Use an approximate analytic horizon-exit/observable treatment because the exact e-fold relation is not analytically solvable. Series in the implementation are truncated at n=65; the authors report that increasing this cutoff changes parameters below their code's numerical sensitivity.

sources.title: String Inflation After Planck 2013

evidence.text: Imported model analyses also use numerical multifield trajectories: uplifted D3-D7 inflation mixes brane position with a geometric modulus, while racetrack inflation lacks a simple analytically extracted single-field potential.

sources.title: String Inflation After Planck 2013

evidence.text: Large-volume constructions organize the low-energy theory in string coupling and inverse cycle sizes. The tree-level Kähler potential K_tree = −2 ln V and extended no-scale structure explain why some moduli enter the potential only at suppressed orders.

sources.title: Fitting string inflation to real cosmological data: The fiber inflation case

evidence.text: Sample a seven-parameter space comprising Ω_bh², Ω_ch², 100θ_MC, optical depth τ, γ, R and V₀ with modified CosmoMC. The analysis uses flat priors, fast/slow parameter decorrelation and a Gelman–Rubin convergence diagnostic; A_s, n_s, r and N_eff are derived.

sources.title: Fitting string inflation to real cosmological data: The fiber inflation case

evidence.text: The baseline is Planck 2018 TTTEEE+lowl+lowE. Separate combinations add R19's Gaussian H₀ prior, 74.03±1.42 km s⁻¹ Mpc⁻¹, BAO, DES year-one 3×2-point data, CMB lensing or Pantheon supernova distances.

sources.title: Confronting Kähler moduli inflation with CMB data

evidence.text: How do the model-dependent duration of post-inflationary modulus domination and uncertain reheating alter the pivot e-fold count, inferred microscopic parameters, and CMB compatibility of Kähler moduli inflation?

sources.title: Moduli inflation from modular flavor symmetries

evidence.text: Can a modulus associated with modular flavor symmetry drive observationally viable slow-roll inflation, remain controlled along its complex trajectory, and settle into a flavor-relevant vacuum?

sources.title: Inflation in realistic D-brane models

evidence.text: Can D3/anti-D3 inflation survive moduli stabilization in warped string models containing Standard Model-like sectors, when the remaining light moduli evolve, and what tuning and CMB signatures result?

sources.title: String Cosmology

evidence.text: These lectures review how string theory might accommodate a small cosmological constant and inflation, emphasizing moduli stabilization, obstacles to flat inflaton potentials, possible remedies, and observational signatures.

sources.title: Oscillons from String Moduli

evidence.text: When can displaced string moduli fragment into oscillons during relaxation toward their post-inflationary minima, and what gravitational-wave signals or decompactification risks follow?

sources.title: String moduli inflation: An overview

evidence.text: How can closed string moduli drive controlled slow-roll inflation after moduli stabilization, which mechanisms address the η-problem, and what observable signatures distinguish the reviewed scenarios?

sources.title: Robust Inflation from Fibrous Strings

evidence.text: How robust are Fibre Inflation potentials and predictions under UV corrections, modulus stabilization and geometric generalization, and how large can their tensor signal become?

sources.title: Moduli Vacuum Misalignment and Precise Predictions in String Inflation

evidence.text: How does explicitly computed moduli vacuum misalignment change the post-inflationary history, preferred horizon-exit e-fold number Ne, and observable predictions of Kähler moduli inflation?

sources.title: String cosmology: From the early universe to today

evidence.text: How can string compactifications and moduli dynamics underpin inflation, post-inflationary evolution and dark energy, and which construction, control and observational challenges remain?

sources.title: Warm warped throats

evidence.text: Can dissipation make moduli-stabilized radial and angular D3-brane inflation compatible with the observational constraints used in the paper, while retaining sub-Planckian excursions and, for angular inflation, a sub-Planckian effective decay constant?

sources.title: String cosmology — Large-field inflation in string theory

evidence.text: How can string theory provide symmetry protection, a trans-Planckian inflaton range and controlled moduli dynamics for large-field inflation, particularly axion monodromy, while connecting the construction to the scalar tilt n_s and tensor-to-scalar ratio r?

sources.title: Inflationary constraints on the moduli-dependent species scale in modular invariant theories

evidence.text: Can inflationary observations directly constrain the moduli-dependent gravitational species scale in modular-invariant inflation, including extensions to generic Calabi–Yau threefolds?

sources.title: Constraints on Kähler moduli inflation from reheating

evidence.text: How do reheating and a post-inflationary epoch dominated by cold volume-modulus particles change the inferred horizon-exit e-fold count and spectral tilt of Kähler moduli inflation, and its compatibility with the Planck datasets available to the authors?

sources.title: Loop Blow-up Inflation: An Overview

evidence.text: Can string-loop corrections that spoil the original non-perturbative blow-up inflation regime instead generate controlled inflation, and what predictions follow after accounting for moduli reheating and dark radiation? This v2 proceedings overview summarizes earlier work and updates observational comparisons and Scenario III parameters.

sources.title: Prospects for Primordial Gravitational Waves in String Inflation

evidence.text: How large can the CMB tensor-to-scalar ratio be when inflation admits both a perturbative-string description and a controlled four-dimensional effective field theory with separated inflationary, Kaluza–Klein and string scales?

sources.title: Power Suppression at Large Scales in String Inflation

evidence.text: Could a transition in closed-string-modulus inflation generate the historically reported low-multipole CMB power suppression, and can Fibre Inflation connect the transition's timing and strength to string coupling and potential parameters?

sources.title: Mass Hierarchies and Dynamical Field Range

evidence.text: Observable tensor modes motivate large inflationary field displacements while raising the Hubble scale. A string construction must fit stabilized moduli, Kaluza-Klein states, and string states into the remaining hierarchy without losing control during axion motion.

sources.title: On inflation in string theory

evidence.text: Can inflation with stabilized moduli be reliably derived from string theory, and which model assumptions could cosmological measurements of scalar tilt, primordial tensors and cosmic strings test?

sources.title: Effect of moduli redefinitions on fibre inflation

evidence.text: Can a logarithmic redefinition of the base modulus in perturbative LVS alter fibre-inflation predictions toward the ACT-favoured spectral tilt quoted by the paper, while supporting subsequent axion quintessence and a partial dark-matter component?

sources.title: Fluxbranes: Moduli Stabilisation and Inflation

evidence.text: Can fluxbrane inflation be combined with controlled moduli stabilization while satisfying the paper's historical curvature-perturbation and cosmic-string constraints, preserving an inflaton flat direction and avoiding an effectively constant FI term?

destination.summary: Separates asymptotic tower existence, exponential rates, fixed exponential envelopes and special physical triggers. Long finite excursions and missing kinetic metrics test the applicability of these claims.

assumptions: A conjecture imported by a source is not independently verified.

conventions: Use source-specific canonical or geodesic distance and Planck normalization.

excludes: A universal mass law established by the supplied packet
